_comment: Canonical workload definitions for the Velocity multi-engine benchmark suite.

core_workloads.name: simple_workflow
core_workloads.description: Start -> execute 10 durable steps -> complete. Baseline throughput and latency.

core_workloads.name: cold_start
core_workloads.description: First workflow execution after engine startup. Measures initialization overhead.

core_workloads.name: signal_storm
core_workloads.description: Start workflow -> send 100 durable signals -> complete. Each signal is a real durable write.
core_workloads.highlights: Velocity: real WAL fsync per signal. Temporal: real event-sourced signals.

core_workloads.name: high_step
core_workloads.description: Single workflow with 50 sequential durable steps. Measures per-step overhead at scale.
core_workloads.highlights: Velocity: zero-copy Rust, slab allocator. Competitors: journal/PG commit per step.

core_workloads.name: concurrent_100
core_workloads.description: Launch 100 workflows in parallel, each with 10 steps. Measures concurrency handling.
core_workloads.highlights: Restate: virtual objects. Velocity: async Rust tokio tasks.

core_workloads.name: memory_scaling
core_workloads.description: Create 1K, 10K, 100K workflows and measure RSS at each level. Tests memory efficiency.
core_workloads.highlights: Velocity: 5.5MB base RSS. Restate: keyed virtual object state.

core_workloads.name: payload_size
core_workloads.description: Vary payload from 1KB to 1MB. Measures serialization and storage overhead.
core_workloads.highlights: Velocity: slab allocator. DBOS: PostgreSQL TOAST. Restate: journal buffering.

velocity-classic.name: wal_group_commit
velocity-classic.description: 1000 sequential ops, each requiring WAL fsync. Measures group commit amortization.
velocity-classic.highlights: Velocity WAL group commit: amortize fsync across multiple ops in same batch.

velocity-classic.name: crash_recovery
velocity-classic.description: Write 10K workflows, kill engine, restart, verify all data recovered from WAL.
velocity-classic.highlights: WAL replay speed, zero data loss guarantee.

velocity-runtime.name: http_throughput
velocity-runtime.description: Pure HTTP/2 multiplexed requests — 1000 concurrent streams on single connection.
velocity-runtime.highlights: HTTP/2 multiplexing vs gRPC binary framing overhead.

velocity-embedded.name: embedded_no_network
velocity-embedded.description: In-process execution with zero network overhead. Direct function call to engine.
velocity-embedded.highlights: Eliminates serialization + network hop. Pure Rust in-memory execution.

dbos.name: pg_transactional
dbos.description: Complex multi-table PostgreSQL transaction: insert into 5 tables with FK constraints in one txn.
dbos.highlights: PostgreSQL ACID transactions — unique to DBOS among workflow engines.

dbos.name: sql_visibility
dbos.description: Run SQL queries over live workflow state while workflows are executing.
dbos.highlights: SQL visibility into workflow state — unique to DBOS (PostgreSQL-native).

restate.name: virtual_object_contention
restate.description: 1000 concurrent mutations on the same keyed virtual object. Tests serialization.
restate.highlights: Restate virtual objects: automatic single-threaded access per key.

restate.name: reactive_chain
restate.description: Handler-to-handler durable call chain: A calls B calls C calls D. Each journaled.
restate.highlights: Restate durable handler-to-handler calls with automatic journaling.

temporal.name: activity_scheduling
temporal.description: Workflow schedules 10 real activities with retry policy, timeout, and heartbeat.
temporal.highlights: Temporal activity framework: real worker processes, retry, timeout, heartbeat.

temporal.name: long_running
temporal.description: 5-minute workflow with timers, signals, and queries interleaved.
temporal.highlights: Temporal event-sourcing: durable timers, signal handling during wait.
